the detection of the influenza virus in the human population.
the development of multiplex real‐ time PCR assays to detect and differentiate between influenza viruses.

the H1N1 virus is a virus that is not as dangerous as it is portrayed by the media and that it is a virus that should be taken seriously.

the H1N1 pandemic was not caused by an animal virus jumping to humans.
